text:
Gabe: Quick catch from QA run — opening the cluster settings modal while a transient toast is visible causes the modal's header and primary action to visibly shift down ~10px. Seen on Chrome/Win and Safari/Mac. Screenshot: https://placeholder.img/modal-toast-shift.png
Anika: Repro'd. Toast is currently part of normal document flow so it pushes the toolbar and header on mount. That explains the visual jump + tabindex confusion.
Seth: A11y note: keyboard users tabbing into the modal see the close button move, which is confusing for screen reader users. We should prevent layout shift.
Gabe: My suggestion: render toasts in a separate fixed UI layer (center top), animate with transform (translateY + opacity) and keep pointer-events: none by default so they don't intercept focus. Also ensure toasts are aria-live=polite so they still announce to SRs.
Renee: Sounds good. Small caveat: on narrow viewports where modals are full-screen, fixed toasts can visually overlap the modal chrome. We'll need z-index rules so modals always sit above toasts.
Anika: Implementation sketch:
```css
.rw-toast { position: fixed; top: 12px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px); opacity: 0; transition: transform .18s ease, opacity .12s ease; pointer-events: none; }
.rw-toast.show { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
.rw-modal { z-index: var(--z-modal, 1200); }
.rw-toast { z-index: var(--z-toast, 900); }
```
Seth: Agree with pointer-events none by default. Also: ensure toasts set aria-hidden when hidden and that they don't steal focus. For dismissible toasts we can enable pointer-events on hover so the dismiss button is clickable.
Gabe: Spacing token question: toolbar uses --space-1 between icon buttons which feels tight when a toast shows. I don't want to change global tokens blindly. Propose we add a component-scoped token --toolbar-gap (8px) and use it for the toolbar layout. If we later promote it we can do a global migration.
Renee: +1. Scoped token approach avoids cascading surprises. We should add a small migration note in DESIGN_TOKENS.md if we add new tokens.
Anika: Focus styles: icon-only buttons currently have a faint 1px ring. WCAG suggests higher contrast. Recommend updating component to use --focus-ring-2 (2px) with color token --color-interactive-focus and outline-offset: 2px. For dark surfaces use --color-focus-inverse.
Seth: Also audit all icon-only controls for missing aria-labels. I found the toolbar\u2014settings, share, and pin\u2014one of them lacks aria-label and reads as "button" to NVDA.
Gabe: Microcopy: the small toast says "Saved" in a few places and "Saved successfully" in others. I'd prefer short toasts like "Saved" for inline actions and slightly longer copy in modals/dialogs ("Changes saved"). Let's add a sentence in content-guidelines.md to clarify.
Renee: Mobile tweak: shorten toast timeout on <= 420px and cap max-height to 48px so it never covers too much of the top area. Also consider reducing horizontal padding for very narrow screens.
Anika: QA automation: I'll add an e2e that triggers a toast while tabbing into the modal and assert two things: 1) document.activeElement is the modal close button after open, and 2) top-of-modal-header y-position delta < 6px between before-toast and after-open (to catch regressions).
Seth: We should also add a visual regression snapshot for the toolbar in states with and without toast so designers can confirm spacing tokens look OK.
Gabe: About z-index conventions: let's add a tiny doc in DESIGN_TOKENS.md with the recommended stacking order and example var names: base < content < toasts < menus < modals < overlays. Mention the portal rule: all interactive floating components (menus/popovers) should render into the global layer to avoid local stacking context bugs.
Renee: Good call. Portalling menus will also fix issues where a table menu gets clipped by a toast due to transform-created stacking contexts. We'll add that guidance to the floating-components doc.
Anika: Dev plan: small PR that 1) moves toast into fixed layer with transform entrance/exit, 2) introduces --toolbar-gap token and updates the toolbar component, 3) strengthens icon focus ring and performs aria-label audit, 4) unifies short toast copy to "Saved" for inline saves and documents the copy rules, 5) mobile toast adjustments.
design-ci: PR opened: redwood/design-system#1299 "toasts: fixed layer + toolbar gap + focus & copy polish" (assigned to Anika)
Gabe: Please include a short migration note about the new token and z-index vars so platform teams know the conventions. Also call out any CSS var names we add.
Seth: I'll run NVDA and VoiceOver smoke tests once PR lands and add a small keyboard nav test.
Renee: I'll take visuals + mobile check. If everyone is happy I'll approve. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Anika: Linking PR now. ETA for reviews: 1-2 hours.
Gabe: Thanks all. Small follow-up: add a test to the design-system CI that renders a modal while a toast is shown to prevent regressions in the future.
Seth: Added to my queue. :rocket:
